positions.name: PallasineChecklistAuthority
positions.frame: what establishes the Pallasine checklist as the current, mandatory onboarding standard?
positions.why: Both expressions come from the same speaker in the same breath about the same artifact: src-1 states the checklist as a universal, present-tense mandate ('Every new hire completes'), and src-2 supplies the institutional history that grounds that mandate — the checklist superseded the old wiki page last quarter. Read together, the authority-ranking framing of src-1 and the supersession fact of src-2 answer one question: why this checklist, now, is the given standard rather than one option among others. No tension — the two expressions reinforce a single institutional-legitimacy read; conviction on src-1 registers as decision-level (ratification of the rule) while src-2 is a supporting factual claim, consistent with a mandate-plus-grounding structure rather than two independent assertions.
